t.t: Planet Mobil shipping & returns information: lead times, carriers, areas served and refund procedure.

div.p: As soon as your order is dispatched, you will receive an email with a tracking number to track your parcel in real time on the carrier's website.

In the event of a damaged parcel upon receipt, make reservations with the carrier and contact us within 48h at contact@planet-mobil.com. In the event of a lost parcel, we will open an investigation with the carrier and offer you a replacement or refund.
In accordance with article L221-18 of the Consumer Code, you have 14 calendar days from receipt of your order to exercise your right of withdrawal, without justification.

ol.li: Contact us by email at contact@planet-mobil.com, quoting your order number
We will send you a return label and packaging instructions
Drop the parcel at a collection point or post office
Refund is made within 14 days of receiving and checking the product

ul.li: The product must be returned in its original packaging
The product must be in perfect condition (unused, undamaged)
Accessories, manuals and warranties must be included
Return costs are borne by the customer (except for defective products)

div.p: If your product has a defect or does not match your order, contact us immediately. Return costs will then be covered by Planet Mobil and a replacement or full refund will be offered.
